headword: {焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}

definitions.gloss: incineration plant; incinerator facility; waste burning facility
definitions.explanation: A facility where waste, garbage, or other materials are burned for disposal. In Japan, municipal incineration plants are a key part of waste management infrastructure.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{処理|しょり}される→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧。
examples.english: Garbage is processed at the incineration plant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some residents oppose the plan to build a new incineration plant.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{排|はい}⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧⟦{処理|しょり}{装置|そうち}→処理装置：23630_shorisouchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧おり、ダイオキシン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}→排出：04632_haishutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えている→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: This incineration plant is equipped with the latest exhaust gas treatment systems and significantly reduces dioxin emissions.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{焼却|しょうきゃく}→焼却：22409_shoukyaku⟧ (incineration) + {場|じょう} (place/facility). Japan incinerates approximately 80% of its municipal waste, making incineration plants a familiar part of urban infrastructure. Many modern facilities also generate electricity from the heat produced.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧{焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}: garbage incineration plant
- {焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧: construction of an incineration plant
- {焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煙突|えんとつ}→煙突：02271_entotsu⟧: incineration plant chimney
- ⟦{産業|さんぎょう}{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}→産業廃棄物：19064_sangyouhaikibutsu⟧{焼却場|しょうきゃくじょう}: industrial waste incineration plant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{焼却炉|しょうきゃくろ}→焼却炉：23880_shoukyakuro⟧: incinerator — the furnace unit itself, not the whole facility
- ⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧: waste processing plant — euphemism used by many municipalities
- ⟦{処理場|しょりじょう}→処理場：09653_shorijou⟧: processing plant — broader term for any waste treatment facility
- ⟦{埋|う}め{立|た}て→埋め立て：12112_umetate⟧{地|ち}: landfill — alternative disposal method where waste is buried
